scenes.headline: Jio IPO: *Listing Day* Strategy!
scenes.voice: Jio IPO listing day fast approach kar raha hai! But main question: Listing day pe Hold karein ya instant Sell?

scenes.headline: Valuation & *(GMP)* Metrics
scenes.voice: Valuation touch kar rahi hai over 100 Billion Dollars! Grey market premium spike ho raha hai, but retail allocations dynamic honge.
scenes.label: Performance Metric

scenes.headline: *Listing Day* Decision Engine
scenes.voice: Toh humara execution flow simple hai: Pre-open price check karo, GMP percentage calculate karo, trailing stop-loss set karo, aur system exit execute karega.

scenes.headline: _Listing Gain_ vs _Long Term HODL_
scenes.voice: Agar 30 percent plus listing gain milta hai, short-term flippers partial profit book kar sakte hain. But long-term 5G scale ke liye HODL solid logic hai.

scenes.headline: Automated *(Trailing SL)* Algo
scenes.voice: Python me aisa simple stop-loss script run kar sakte ho taaki listing day pe zero emotions ke saath profit lock ho sake!

scenes.headline: 4 *Critical Risks* to Track
scenes.voice: Ye 4 factors launch day pe zaroor monitor karna: Telecom ARPU rate, market volatility, FII flows, aur retail sector margins.
